context: Tests whether the agent correctly implements the multi-gene warfarin recommendation using both CYP2C9 and VKORC1, produces the required output directory structure, and includes a medical disclaimer.

checklist.name: CYP2C9 gene in report
checklist.description: report.md or result.json includes CYP2C9 gene profile information

checklist.name: VKORC1 gene in report
checklist.description: report.md or result.json includes VKORC1 gene profile information

checklist.name: Warfarin uses both genes
checklist.description: The warfarin drug entry in report.md or result.json references both CYP2C9 and VKORC1 (not just one gene)

checklist.name: Warfarin classification present
checklist.description: report.md or result.json contains a classification for warfarin (one of: standard, caution, avoid, indeterminate)

checklist.name: Disclaimer in report
checklist.description: report.md contains a disclaimer stating this is for research/educational use and not a substitute for clinical advice

checklist.name: CPIC reference
checklist.description: report.md or result.json mentions CPIC or cpicpgx.org as the source of drug-gene guidelines

checklist.name: Drug summary section
checklist.description: report.md contains a drug summary or drug recommendations table

checklist.name: No external packages
checklist.description: warfarin_analysis.py does NOT import any non-standard-library packages
